description: Header file defining classes and structures related to Vertex Attributes and Bindings in the ANGLE graphics library, including VertexBinding and VertexAttribute classes, with associated methods and data structures.

classes.name: VertexBinding
classes.description: Represents a binding point for vertex attributes, managing stride, divisor, offset, and buffer association.

classes.name: VertexAttribute
classes.description: Represents a vertex attribute, including format, pointer, binding index, and cached element limit.

classes.name: VertexAttribCurrentValueData
classes.description: Holds current value data for vertex attributes, supporting float, int, and unsigned int types.

methods.name: updateCachedElementLimit
methods.description: Updates the cached element limit based on the binding.

methods.name: setFloatValues
methods.description: Sets float values for the current attribute data.

methods.name: setIntValues
methods.description: Sets integer values for the current attribute data.

methods.name: setUnsignedIntValues
methods.description: Sets unsigned integer values for the current attribute data.
